description.en: Local AgentJev-0.6B typed-decision model (jev_service) adapted onto the Jev-compatible /v1/systemone surface.
description.zh: 本地 AgentJev-0.6B 决策模型（jev_service），经转换接入 Jev 兼容的 /v1/systemone 面。

description.en: Anthropic Claude API provider with Messages protocol support.
description.zh: Anthropic Claude API 提供商，支持 Messages 协议。

description.en: Google Antigravity provider. The gateway folds every client dialect — text and image alike — onto the gemini arm; the plugin keeps only the Code Assist v1internal envelope and the token-count verb.
description.zh: Google Antigravity Provider。文本与图像方言均由网关折到 gemini 臂,插件只保留 Code Assist v1internal 包装与 token 计数动词。

description.en: Ships the Agent Plan, the Team Max seat and the Coding Plan in one module. Signed Ark Agent Plan, Team seat and Coding Plan quota plus model catalogs.
description.zh: 同一模块内提供 Agent Plan、Team Max 团队席位与 Coding Plan 三档套餐。 方舟 Agent Plan、团队席位与 Coding Plan 签名配额及模型目录。

description.en: Speaks the Claude family over Bedrock's runtime API. AWS Bedrock Claude via the native Messages-shaped invoke API: SigV4-signed requests, eventstream rendered as Anthropic SSE, and the foundation-model catalog.
description.zh: 通过 Bedrock 运行时 API 接入 Claude 系列模型。 AWS Bedrock Claude：原生 Messages 形状的 invoke API，SigV4 签名请求，eventstream 转译为 Anthropic SSE，附基础模型目录。

description.en: Cerebras high-throughput OpenAI-compatible inference with account model discovery.
description.zh: Cerebras 高吞吐 OpenAI 兼容推理，含账号模型发现。

description.en: Cline desktop AI coding assistant: WorkOS OAuth device login, token refresh, and model discovery over the Cline catalog (free tier, Cline Pass, Cline Cloud) plus the OpenRouter passthrough list — free models are marked free in their names. Quota polling reports the balance, the Cline Pass usage windows and the account's membership tier.
description.zh: Cline 桌面端 AI 编程助手：WorkOS OAuth 设备码登录、令牌自动续期；模型发现覆盖 Cline 自有目录（免费额度 / Cline Pass / Cline Cloud）与 OpenRouter 直通列表，免费模型在名称里标注「(免费)」。配额查询报告余额、Cline Pass 额度窗口与账号会员等级。

description.en: Signs in with ChatGPT (SIWC) and shares the 1455 callback port with the legacy Codex plugin — link one at a time. Official Sign in with ChatGPT (SIWC) route onto the public OpenAI Responses endpoint: OAuth access token as Bearer, pinned store:false/stream:true, dynamic model catalog. Shares the 1455 callback port with the legacy Codex plugin — link one at a time, not both at once.
description.zh: 以「使用 ChatGPT 登录」(SIWC) 接入，回跳端口 1455 与旧 Codex 插件相同——请勿同时发起两份登录。 官方“使用 ChatGPT 登录”（SIWC）接入公共 OpenAI Responses 端点：OAuth 访问令牌作 Bearer、钉死 store:false/stream:true、动态模型目录。回跳端口 1455 与旧 Codex 插件相同——请勿同时发起两份登录。

description.en: CommandCode multi-model API with Chat, Responses and Claude Messages, API-key account setup and model-specific routing.
description.zh: CommandCode 多模型 API，支持 Chat、Responses 与 Claude Messages，提供 API Key 账号配置与按模型协议路由。

description.en: Cursor Connect-RPC fingerprint, in-band error classification, usage windows and model catalog.
description.zh: Cursor Connect-RPC 指纹、带内错误分类、用量窗口与模型目录。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) official OpenAI-compatible API with account model discovery; the plugin carries the Qwen dialect mapping for web search, thinking, and incremental streaming.
description.zh: 阿里云百炼（DashScope）官方 OpenAI 兼容 API，含账号模型发现；插件内置千问方言映射：联网搜索、思考模式与增量流式输出。
DeepSeek 第一方 API：OpenAI/Responses/Anthropic 三臂同 Key，并轮询账户余额。
description.en: DeepSeek's first-party API: OpenAI, Responses and Anthropic arms on one key, plus account balance.
Devin account login via the same PKCE flow the Devin CLI uses, Connect-RPC chat, usage windows and the CLI model catalog collapsed to one row per family with its reasoning efforts.
description.zh: 通过 Devin CLI 同款 PKCE 流程登录 Devin 账号，Connect-RPC 对话，用量窗口；CLI 模型目录按家族折叠为一行并列出其推理档位。

description.en: Google Gemini API (AI Studio) with native generateContent transform for OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and Responses, plus the native gemini arm that forwards the gateway's pre-folded generateContent bodies (chat-surface image generation included).
description.zh: Google Gemini API（AI Studio）：在插件内把 OpenAI Chat / Anthropic Messages / Responses 转成 generateContent，并提供原生 gemini 臂，透传网关折好的 generateContent 体（含 chat 面生图）。

description.en: The Gemini macOS app's own channel: gRPC to the Robin edge, the app's model picker (Flash / Pro / Argon / Flash-Lite), and its quota verb. The plugin speaks the app's private protobuf schema directly.
description.zh: Gemini macOS App 自带通道：走 Robin 边缘的 gRPC、App 同款模型选择器（Flash / Pro / Argon / Flash-Lite）与配额查询。插件直接说 App 的私有 protobuf 协议。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan (Zhipu) via BigModel OAuth. Sign-in mints the coding-plan API key chat actually accepts.
description.zh: 通过 BigModel OAuth 登录接入 GLM Coding Plan（智谱）。登录后会铸造聊天真正使用的 Coding Plan API Key。

description.en: Groq's low-latency OpenAI and Responses APIs with account model discovery.
description.zh: Groq 的低延迟 OpenAI 与 Responses API，含账号模型发现。

description.en: Moonshot's coding endpoint. Kimi Coding OpenAI and Anthropic arms, prompt-cache usage, quota windows, and model catalog.
description.zh: 月之暗面的 Coding 端点。 由 Provider 插件提供 Kimi Coding 的 OpenAI / Anthropic 双臂、提示缓存用量、配额窗口与模型目录。

description.en: Backed by AWS CodeWhisperer. Kiro CodeWhisperer fingerprint, profile ARN resolution, usage windows and model listing.
description.zh: 底层由 AWS CodeWhisperer 提供。 Kiro（CodeWhisperer）指纹、profile ARN 解析、用量窗口与模型目录。

description.en: MiMo's 30-day Token Plan: browser OAuth login on the open platform mints the serving key automatically; optional console cookies keep quota metering alive.
description.zh: MiMo 30 天 Token Plan：通过开放平台浏览器 OAuth 登录自动领取推理密钥；可选的控制台 Cookie 继续支撑额度计量。

description.en: The Xiaomi MiMo desktop app's own account channel: the host opens a Xiaomi-account login window, harvests the session cookies itself, and the MiMo X models unlock — chat on the app's route gateway with cycle usage and the live model catalog. Falls back to pasting the account cookie on headless deployments.
description.zh: 小米 MiMo 桌面 App 自带账号通道：宿主自动打开小米账号登录窗口并收割会话 Cookie，直接解锁 MiMo X 模型——走 App 同款 route 网关聊天，附带周期额度与实时模型目录。无浏览器环境可退回手动粘贴账号 Cookie。

description.en: MiniMax token-plan quota windows, subscription tier, and model catalog carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 MiniMax 套餐配额窗口、订阅等级与模型目录。
Ollama 云端与官方托管模型服务：支持 OpenAI / Responses 协议、官方余额与百分比配额窗口、账户等级与模型目录。
description.en: Ollama Cloud official model service: OpenAI / Responses protocols, official balance and percent quota windows, account tier, and model catalog.
OpenAI API provider with GPT models, Codex image-model chat compatibility, billing windows, and banked rate-limit reset credits.
description.zh: OpenAI API 提供商，支持 GPT 模型、Codex 图像模型 Chat 兼容、额度窗口，以及限额重置券查询与使用。

description.en: OpenCode's free-tier models on opencode.ai/inference, with live model discovery and multi-identity account isolation.
description.zh: opencode.ai/inference 免费档模型，支持在线动态发现模型列表与多账号独立身份隔离。

description.en: OpenCode Go usage windows and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 OpenCode Go 用量窗口与模型目录。

description.en: OpenCode Zen prepaid balance and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 OpenCode Zen 预付余额与模型目录。

description.en: OpenRouter's OpenAI, Anthropic Messages, and Responses APIs with account model discovery and API-key credit limits.
description.zh: OpenRouter 的 OpenAI、Anthropic Messages 与 Responses API，含账号模型发现和 API Key 额度上限。

description.en: Perplexity Sonar search models with OpenAI-compatible chat, streaming, citations, and account model discovery.
description.zh: Perplexity Sonar 搜索模型，支持 OpenAI 兼容对话、流式、引用与账号模型发现。

description.en: Qianwen console quota windows and subscription model catalog carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供千问控制台配额窗口与订阅模型目录。

description.en: The domestic deployment (formerly Lingma / 通义灵码). Qoder CN COSY signing, stream unwrap, quota windows and model catalog.
description.zh: 国内部署（原通义灵码 Lingma）。 Qoder 国内版 COSY 签名、流解码、配额窗口与模型目录。

description.en: Qoder International COSY signing, stream unwrap, quota windows and model catalog.
description.zh: Qoder 国际版 COSY 签名、流解码、配额窗口与模型目录。

description.en: SenseNova Token Plan OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Responses-compatible API, with U1 Fast image-generation size adaptation, reasoning normalized onto the standard reasoning_content on both the streaming and non-streaming paths, and exact seven-model Token Plan catalog filtering including deepseek-flash. The Responses arm is stateless: no previous_response_id, no response storage, streaming ends with response.completed and carries no [DONE]; note that store/background now reach upstream, so an explicit true is rejected with 400 instead of being silently dropped by the gateway bridge.
description.zh: 商汤日日新 Token Plan 的 OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Responses 兼容 API：支持 U1 Fast 图像生成尺寸适配、流式与非流式两条路径上统一归一到标准 reasoning_content 字段，以及包含 deepseek-flash 的精确七模型 Token Plan 目录过滤。Responses 臂为无状态：不支持 previous_response_id 与响应存储，流式以 response.completed 结束且不携带 [DONE]；注意 store/background 现已直达上游，显式传 true 会收到 400，而不再被网关桥接静默丢弃。

description.en: SiliconFlow's OpenAI-compatible model service with account model discovery and balance display.
description.zh: 硅基流动的 OpenAI 兼容模型服务，含账号模型发现与余额显示。

description.en: Sells credits under the Step Plan. Step Plan credit and rolling-window quota carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 以 Step Plan 形式销售额度。 由 Provider 插件提供 Step Plan Credits 与滚动窗口配额。

description.en: Sells credits under the Step Plan. Step Plan international API with monthly Credits and top-up quota.
description.zh: 以 Step Plan 形式销售额度。 阶跃星辰 Step Plan 国际版 API，支持月度 Credits 与加购额度。

description.en: Tencent Cloud LLM Service TokenHub and Token Plan (Enterprise & Personal) with OpenAI / Responses / Anthropic multi-protocol API, quota polling and model catalog.
description.zh: 腾讯云大模型服务平台 TokenHub 与 Token Plan（企业版 / 个人版）OpenAI / Responses / Anthropic 多协议接口、额度查询与模型目录。

description.en: TypeSafe System One (Jev): typed decisions on POST /v1/systemone.
description.zh: TypeSafe System One（Jev）：POST /v1/systemone 上的带类型决策。

description.en: Vercel AI Gateway multi-provider model routing, balance quota, subscription tier filtering, and OpenAI / Anthropic / Responses / Decisions protocol support.
description.zh: Vercel AI Gateway 多供应商模型路由，支持余额额度查询、订阅套餐模型筛选，以及 OpenAI / Anthropic / Responses / Decisions 决策协议。

description.en: Tencent's WorkBuddy (the CodeBuddy agent line). WorkBuddy quota and account model catalog carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 腾讯 WorkBuddy（CodeBuddy 智能体产品线）。 由 Provider 插件提供 WorkBuddy 配额与账号模型目录。

description.en: WorkBuddy AI account model catalog, quota, OAuth, and chat provider for the international service.
description.zh: 面向 WorkBuddy AI 国际服务的账号模型目录、配额、OAuth 与聊天 Provider。

description.en: xAI Grok OAuth login, billing windows, model listing, image generation/editing, api.x.ai request/stream repairs, and the Grok Voice realtime (live voice) surface, carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 xAI Grok OAuth 登录、计费窗口、模型目录、图像生成与编辑、api.x.ai 请求/流式修复，以及 Grok Voice 实时语音（realtime）能力。
